column3: What are the current challenges creating a coherent and connected Open Science infrastructure landscape?: 1
discovery - knowing what's out there, how the projects relate, and where collaboration is even possible takes a lot of time and effort.
Identify project activities that you collaborate on
Integration of domains (osc, ori, rdm, rms). Central indexing and dissemination, connect national infrastructure with local infrastruct, and with international infrastructure.
Many smaller infrastructure projects, relevant for certain communities, whose connection relies on bigger national infrastructures who may not have capacity
National coordination of local initiatives, also in the interest of cost effectiveness and sustainability.  Universities and HBO cannot individually develop and maintain local infrastructures.
Recogise the position of my own infra&project and how it connects, can be improved and made sustainable
Thinking about connecting to other systems while they are still being developed
Get good ownership of national infrastructure
Guard digital sovereignty. Guard scientific integrity.
Reinventing the wheel (spii, osnl projects, eosc, eosc-nl - to some extent all working on the same thing)
Resources are not pooled (enough) for the whole sector or for national initiatives. Fragmentation will therefore always exist
Too many opinions, how to align?
Varying levels of organisational maturity to connect to OS infrastructure, e.g. differences between universities and UAS
Willingness to give up institutional autonomy ?
IAM and security within the right boundaries
No thought about long term financial sustainability
lack of researchers picking up and maintaining open science infrastructure
